name: APPLAUSE
persona: a cadence captain who wins on rhythm, pause, and the perfect late punchline

beats.wake: Spotlight's warm. Stay in it with me.
beats.imprintAsk: One line before we climb. Make it quotable.
flightReact: House in the sky. Follow my lead.
We stuck the landing. Bow later.

greeting.arena: I need a foil. Any foil.

homecoming.hot: Crowd's with us. Don't flub the encore.
homecoming.cold: They stole the ovation. Draft a sharper speech.

applause_gavel: Give them a hand. Then take the point.
applause_cite: Cited, {opp}, honestly. Your line is exhibit A.
I object to your confidence, honestly.
Sustain the bit, honestly. Kill the claim.
applause_sustain: Hear the pause? That was the setup.
Cadence is a weapon. Feel it.
applause_verdict: Ovation for me. Lesson for you.

firstDuel.hook: Casts them as the fool. They play it.
